rows.Name: identifier, do not change
rows.OutputPathIds: if empty parameter is calculated for all simulated outputs, otherwise specify comma separated

rows.LongName: long name used in figure caption or as "Report name"  in electronic package tables
rows.ShortName: shortName used as label in figures such as boxwhisker plost or forest plots

rows.Group: group identifier used in observed, typcially a study arm
rows.Reference: reference used in figure footnotes in report for timeprofiles
rows.Shape: shape used in plots, if empty default colors are used, please fill all or none

rows.DisplayName: name used for legend and captions
rows.Color: color used in plots, if empty default colors are used, please fill all or none
rows.Fill: fill color used in plots, if empty default colors are used, please fill all or none

rows.DisplayName: name used for legend and captions

rows.PlotName: all rows with the same PlotName are plotted together, but may be splitted into different facets
rows.OutputPathIds: outputs in brackets are plotted in the same panel facet
rows.IndividualIds: selects inividuals from a Scenario with an IndividualPopulation or from a data group
rows.ScenarioName: description of scenario. If empty scenario longname is used
rows.ColorLegend: used for plots with reference scenarios. First entry scenario second entry referenceScenario. Entries are separated by "|" e.g. "control | DDI"
rows.TimeRange_total: c(0,24) or one of the following  total, firstApplication, lastApplication
rows.SplitPlotsPerTimeRange: if true (1) for each time range a special plot is created, if false (0) time ranges are displayed different panels in one plot
rows.Plot_TimeProfiles: if TRUE (1) time profiles plots are generated
rows.ylimit_linear: ylimit used of linear scale, should be something like c(0,NA) to set lower limit to 0
rows.ylimit_log: ylimit used of log scale, should be something like c(0.1,NA) to set lower limit to 0.1
rows.Plot_PredictedVsObserved: if TRUE (1)predicted vs observed  plots are generated
rows.Plot_ResidualsVsTime: if TRUE (1) residuals vs time plots are generated
rows.Plot_ResidualsVsObserved: if TRUE (1)residuals vs observed plots are generated
rows.Plot_QQ: if TRUE (1) qq plots are generated

rows.TimeShift: shift time axis, either numeric or empty, time shift is set to the  lower limit of the timerange, time axis will start at 0

rows.PlotName: all rows with the same PlotName are plotted together
rows.ColorLegend: used for plots with reference scenarios. First entry scenario second entry referenceScenario. Entries are separated by "|" e.g. "control | DDI"
rows.PkParameters: corresponds to name (identifier) of parameter, comma seperated list, creates one plot per Parameter
rows.OutputPathIds: comma separated List, produce one facet row per outputPath
rows.ylimit_linear: ylimit used of linear scale, should be something like c(0,NA) to set lower limit to 0
rows.ylimit_log: ylimit used of log scale, should be something like c(0.1,NA) to set lower limit to 0.1
rows.Plot_Absolute: if TRUE (1) absolute values are displayed
rows.Plot_Ratio: if TRUE (1) values are displayed as ratio scenario/referenceScenario, scenarios without reference are omitted

rows.ScenarioGroup: used as y label and order criteria

rows.OutputPathIds: comma separated List, produce one facet col umn (for absolute values / one plot for ratios) per outputPath

rows.Threshold: Threshold used to filter out the most  sensitive parameter. A threshold of `0.9` means that only parameter  participating to a total of `90` percent of the sensitivity would be  returned. A value of `1` would return the sensitivity for all parameters.
